evidence.restatement: Marco Polo, a Venetian merchant, described his years in the service of Kublai Khan.
Kublai Khan died in 1294, long before Cabot, Columbus and Vespucci were born, so none of them served at his court.
Polo dictated his account while a prisoner of the Genoese, around 1298.
His fellow prisoner Rustichello da Pisa, an author of romances, wrote the account down.
